scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The registered worker should have at least one year of regular membership.
Only the first two children of the worker are eligible for the scheme.
benefits_summary: Free coaching assistance is provided to the first two children of registered construction workers for competitive examinations.
